note.en: Original equations from docs/45 §4, with epsilon .08, chord 1 m, reference area 2 m²; illustrative stall knots (12,1), (16,.85), (20,.60), signed mirror. Fixed-density fixture 1.225 kg/m³, V40 alpha4: Cl .47075898801417243, lift 922.687616507778 N. NASA atmosphere uses the full S11 constant set; h0/5000/10000 density 1.226613787410970/.7376745768470427/.4140080791698312. No viscous separation, finite-wing correction, drag or flight dynamics. Part thickness .12 m is illustrative, not reference span. Paths use RK4 and nondimensional time, slowed 80-fold. Original geometry and implementation, no third-party coordinates or software. Not wind-tunnel data or aircraft performance.
note.zh: 采用 docs/45 §4 原创教学规则，ε=.08、弦长 1 m、参考面积 2 m²，人工失速折线为 (12,1)、(16,.85)、(20,.60)，正负镜像。固定密度夹具为 1.225 kg/m³，V40、迎角4时 Cl=.47075898801417243、升力922.687616507778 N。NASA 大气采用 S11 完整常数组；h0/5000/10000 的密度为1.226613787410970/.7376745768470427/.4140080791698312。不计算黏性分离、有限翼修正、阻力或飞行动力学。厚度 .12 m 仅为示意，并非参考翼展。RK4 流线按无量纲时间推进，放慢80倍。原创几何与代码，不含外部坐标或软件。不是风洞数据或飞机性能。
